title: Ghidra xref evidence
description: Generate independent Ghidra call, data, and control-reference evidence for knowledge-graph ingestion.
status_message: The xref exporter writes stable evidence rows that the knowledge graph links to current functions.
limitations: The live runner requires Ghidra analyzeHeadless, Java 21, and build/GALE01/main.elf.
Only resolved call and data references become structured graph edges; unresolved rows remain searchable evidence chunks.
Refresh the export after rebuilding the ELF, then rebuild the knowledge graph.

usage.agent_guidance: Refresh evidence as maintenance; workers consume it through knowledge_graph_search, graph_related_functions, and code_graph_file_card.
